issues.detail: Preserved sm/md fixed heights are 36/40px; compact density is 32px. These are not automatically a WCAG failure because spacing exceptions and caller hit-area extensions exist, but source sizing does not prove 44px nonoverlapping mobile reachability.
issues.fix: Test actual compact/narrow toolbars with long labels and existing touch-target utilities; retain sizes/defaults and apply existing target extension only where required.

issues.detail: Muted contrast helper evaluates opaque mode surfaces, not every translucent/control/hover/composed background or chart series. No runtime AA claim follows from this helper.
issues.fix: Reuse helper; verify effective text/UI contrast across open states/custom accents/light/dark and forced colors after restrained palette integration.

issues.detail: paginatedQueryPolicy uses keepPreviousData and explicitly requires same-scope adoption. A scope-bearing key prevents cache contamination but placeholderData may still show previous-scope rows if callers use the helper indiscriminately. No offending consumer is established in this sample.
issues.fix: Keep existing helper; require targeted scope-change tests for adopting lists and guard same-scope placeholder reuse at caller boundaries before changing shared behavior.

visualIssues.detail: neonColorMap still supplies colored 15px glows, neon rings/borders/dots and maps neutral to blue via semanticToNeon. IconBox uses cyan by default; saturation is shared default vocabulary, not just user opt-in.
visualIssues.fix: Extend existing map with restrained semantic foreground/tint/border treatment and no decorative glow; keep export/API compatibility and data-state labels; neutral must read as neutral.

visualIssues.rule: Latest user restrained-palette mandate; mission visual intensity
visualIssues.detail: Global utilities expose glow-cyan/purple/blue backgrounds, mesh gradient, glow shadows and infinite glow-pulse/border-flow animations. Neutral e1/e2/e3 alternatives already exist.
visualIssues.fix: Design architect specifies restrained replacements/compatibility aliases in the existing config; audit real consumers before removing utilities; use neutral elevation rather than halo decoration.

visualIssues.rule: Latest user no decorative glow; MDC-042
visualIssues.detail: Every spinner SVG applies spinner-bolt-glow. CSS has two theme-colored drop shadows; reduced-motion branch stops drawing but intentionally retains glow.
visualIssues.fix: Keep loading role/name/size and meaningful static reduced-motion state; remove decorative drop-shadow stack through existing Spinner/CSS owner.

visualIssues.detail: pulse-glow and glow-line remain global ambient halo/gradient-loop APIs although glass-glow classes at598-602 already resolve neutral panel shadows.
visualIssues.fix: Inventory mounted callers and replace ambient decoration with static neutral emphasis; retain legitimate loading/state feedback and reduced-motion behavior.

visualIssues.detail: glassCardClasses still chooses bg-white and border-white literal alpha chrome instead of --panel/--surface/--border variables used by Card/GlassPanel.
visualIssues.fix: Route existing convenience classes through current panel tokens without changing padding, shape or public exports.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-034 chart chrome; latest user white/neon reduction
visualIssues.detail: Chart brush stroke is fixed cyan; brush fill and synced cursor are fixed white alpha. ChartBrush consumes the brush map directly, so these are live shared presentation paths, not merely unused examples.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing theme-aware semantic chart/control/border variables for brush and cursor; preserve selection dimensions, callbacks, index semantics and visible contrast.

visualIssues.detail: Theme-derived chart series clamp saturation to at least0.5 and as high as0.95. Separate static and preference palettes also exist; existing subdued brand CSS alone cannot restrain all series.
visualIssues.fix: Coordinate one chart-presentation policy with existing palette owners; reduce nonessential chroma while preserving distinguishable series/semantic meanings/user preference IDs and accessible alternatives.

visualIssues.detail: --control-thumb is pure white; on-accent white at60 is contrast-driven, unlike ornamental emphasis. Generated presets also include white primary text, e.g.themePresets.ts:24.
visualIssues.fix: Architect distinguishes necessary readable on-fill/system/print whites from decoration; subdue thumb/decorative emphasis with existing tokens and measured contrast, never blindly replace all white or reset presets.

visualIssues.detail: rdp-tesla still uses --accent fallback blue, literal white selected text and white-alpha navigation hover rather than current theme/control/on-primary owners.
visualIssues.fix: Retheme existing RangePicker calendar through current semantic controls and readable foreground; preserve range geometry, day selection, focus and workspace ownership.

architectureIssues.detail: HAND-MAINTAINED preload map lacks /day-log, /battery-passport and /vehicle-management, declared in App.tsx:852,855,583. Missing entries silently skip speculation; this is not a broken navigation claim.
architectureIssues.fix: Extend existing prefetch map and bounded route/preload drift checks; preserve literal dynamic imports, bandwidth gate, failed-download eviction and DEV boundaries.

architectureIssues.detail: CHART_COLORS CB-safe, neon preference, theme-derived series and chartTokens.series use different series owners; the latter is a different eight-color palette despite its CB-safe comment.
architectureIssues.fix: Document intentional semantic-vs-categorical distinctions and unify shared series selection at existing hooks/tokens without removing persisted preferences or changing domain color meaning.

architectureIssues.rule: Executable gate must inspect actual palette
architectureIssues.detail: Validator checks duplicated arrays and only four anchor literals in production source at124-129. A changed interior source color can escape adjacency validation; comment claiming other-entry drift trips adjacency is unsupported.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing dependency/tooling to validate every ordered production entry against the audited palette or load one canonical data representation. Also cover chartTokens and theme-derived results after policy clarification.

architectureIssues.detail: Allowed-direct-import table says only four owners may import Lucide, but CLEAN-08 text at118 onward says per-route direct imports preserve locality. icons.ts:4 repeats unconditional registry-only rule; Vite intentionally avoids vendor-icons grouping.
architectureIssues.fix: Architect/tooling owner reconciles concept routing with lazy icon locality; do not bulk-rewrite feature imports into an eager registry or add another icon library.

architectureIssues.detail: QueryScope.end is documented inclusive while useRangeState.ts:120-125 exposes endInstantExclusive. Transport names alone cannot prove server interpretation.
architectureIssues.fix: Document exact per-endpoint boundary mapping and add existing scope/range/domain contract tests; do not change backend filter semantics or infer units during palette work.

architectureIssues.detail: Pre-auth raw settings fetch and provider-local theme persistence coexist with TanStack useSettings. This is an explicitly documented bootstrap exception, not authorization to replace the provider with a second theme engine.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve bootstrap/localStorage/custom-color behavior and audit hydration/cross-tab/persistence races only in a separately scoped integration item.
